title: When More Is Not Better: Component Anti-Synergy in a P300 Speller
abstract: arXiv:2609.10961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: P300 brain-computer interface (BCI) spellers can provide hands-free communication for people with severe motor impairments. Modern pipelines combine multiple individually promising components, often assuming that 'more-is-better'. We tested this assumption using a four-component full-factorial experiment varying the inclusion of Euclidean Alignment (EA), xDAWN spatial filtering, subject calibration, and language model priors on a public P300 dataset. Performance was evaluated using accuracy, repetitions, and information transfer rate (ITR) with mixed-effects models. Results show that the value of components is conditional rather than additive. Calibration was the strongest singular contributor, while EA compensated for its absence in zero-calibration settings. Adding independently useful components could also reduce performance, revealing component anti-synergy. Contrary to conventional wisdom, LM support was not universally beneficial:

translated_title: 当更多并非更好：P300拼写器中的组件反协同效应
translated_abstract: P300脑机接口（BCI）拼写器可以为严重运动障碍患者提供免手操作的沟通方式。现代处理流程通常会组合多个单独表现良好的组件，并往往假设“多多益善”。我们通过一个四组件全因子实验来检验这一假设，该实验在公开的P300数据集上改变欧几里得对齐（EA）、xDAWN空间滤波、受试者校准和语言模型先验的包含情况。性能通过准确率、重复次数和信息传输率（ITR）进行评估，并采用混合效应模型进行分析。结果表明，组件的价值是条件性的而非简单叠加的。受试者校准是最强的单一贡献因素，而欧几里得对齐则在校准缺失的零校准设置中起到了补偿作用。添加各自独立有用的组件也可能降低性能，从而揭示了组件反协同效应。与传统观念相反，语言模型的支持并非普遍有益：
tldr: 该研究通过全因子实验发现P300拼写器中各组件的价值是条件性的而非可叠加的，即使各自有用的组件组合也可能产生反协同效应导致性能下降，其中受试者校准是最强的单一贡献因素，语言模型支持并非普遍有益。
en_tdlr: A full-factorial experiment on P300 spellers reveals that component benefits are conditional rather than additive—individually useful components can exhibit anti-synergy and degrade performance, with subject calibration being the strongest single contributor and language model support not universally beneficial.
